title: FiveM: "Steam must be running" or "Unable to find SteamID"
summary: The server wants to see your Steam account and FiveM can't find it. Starting Steam first, signed in, fixes it most of the time.
cause: Some FiveM servers check your Steam account before letting you in. If Steam isn't open, isn't signed in, or FiveM started before it, the check fails.
steps: Close FiveM and Steam completely. Right-click the Steam icon in the system tray (bottom right) and choose Exit.
Open Steam and sign in. Make sure it isn't in Offline Mode (Steam menu at the top left).
Wait until Steam is fully loaded, then open FiveM and join the server again.
Open Steam and FiveM the same way: if you run one as administrator, run the other as administrator too.
If a server keeps failing, try another. Not every server requires Steam, and some servers set theirs up wrong.
ifStillBroken: If other Steam-checking servers work and only one fails, tell that server's staff. Their Steam setup may be the problem.
